title: HB 892 (89R): Relating to requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote.
operative_text:

(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.

(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) SECTION 1 (amends Election Code 13.002(a))
(quote) (a) A person desiring to register to vote must submit an application and proof of citizenship as required under Subsection (a-1) to the registrar of the county in which the person resides.
(section) SECTION 1 (adds 13.002(a-1))
(quote) (a-1) A person desiring to register to vote shall submit to the registrar a copy of one of the following documents: (1) a United States passport or passport card issued to the person; (2) a certified copy of a birth certificate issued by a United States state or territory, or the District of Columbia; (3) United States citizenship papers issued to the person; (4) identification issued by the agency of the United States responsible for citizenship and immigration; or (5) for citizens born abroad, a certificate of report of birth or consular report of birth abroad issued by the United States Department of State.
(section) SECTION 2 (amends 13.039(a))
(quote) (a) On receipt of a registration application, a volunteer deputy registrar shall review it for completeness in the applicant's presence and verify the applicant's citizenship using the proof of citizenship required by Section 13.002(a-1).
(other) Sec 1: proof of citizenship with registration application (13.002).
(other) Sec 2: volunteer deputy registrar must verify citizenship using that proof (13.039(a)).
(other) Sec 3: effective Jan 1, 2026, only if the voters approve the constitutional amendment on proof of citizenship proposed by the 89th Legislature; otherwise no effect.
